book.name: Yohannisa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Yohannisi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Yesusi Tumu Woyne Miththas Ano
Qasseka Yesusi, «Tumu woyne miththa anoy tana; atakilteza oosanchchay ta Aawa.
Ta bolla dishe ayfe immontta hagga ubbaa ta Aaway qanxxi diggana; ayfiza haggaa gujji ayfana mala qirxi geeshshana.
Ta inttes yootida qaalaa gaason intte ha7i geeshshata.
Tanan diite; tanikka inttenan daana; haggay woyne ano bolla dontta aggiko barkka ayfe ayfana dandayonttayssa mala intteka tanan dontta aggiko ayfe ayfanaas dandayekketa.
«Tani woyne miththas ano; intte qasse haggata; daro ayfe ayfizaadey tanan dizaadenne tanikka izan dizaade; gaasoykka ta baynda intte aykkoka ooththanaas dandayekketa.
Tanan bayndaadey qanxxettidi wora yegettida haggaa mala kare yegettidi heen melana; heyta mala haggati issi bolla shiiqidi taman yegettannanne eexxana.
Intte tanan diikko ta qaalaykka inttenan diikko intte koyidayssa oychchiko demmana.
Daro ayfe intte ayfishin ta Aaway bonchchettees; intte tana kaallizayta gididayssi hessan erettana.
«Aaway tana dosidayssaththo tanikka inttena dosadis; hessa gishshas intte ta siiqon diite.
Tani ta Aawaa azazo polada iza siiqon dida mala intteka ta azazo polikko ta siiqon daana.
Hayssa ta inttes yootizay ta ufayssi inttenan gidana malanne intte ufayssika kumeth gidanaassa.
Ta inttes immiza azazoy ta inttena siiqida mala intteka intte giddon issoy issaara siiqettanaassa.
Asi ba lagges ba shemppo aaththi imoppe aadhdhiza siiqoy deenna.
Ta inttena azazizayssa ubbaa intte polikko intte ta laggeta.
Ashkaray goday ooththizayssa erontta gishshas hayssafe guye ta inttena ashkarata giikke. Gido attiin tani ta Aawappe siyidayssa wursa inttes qonccisida gishshas ta inttena ta laggeta gadis.

Ta inttena dooradis attiin intte tana dooribeekketa; intte biidi daro ayfe ayfana mala intte ayfey eqqi daana mala ta inttena woththadis; hessa gishshas intte ta sunththan woossidayssa ubbaa ta Aaway inttes immana.
Hessa gishshas intte intte giddon issoy issaara siiqettana mala ta inttena azazays.
Yesusi Bana Kaallizayta Alamey Ixxanayssa Yootides
«Kaaleththidikka Yesusi inttena alamey ixxiko inttefe kase tana ixxidayssa erite.
Intte ammanontta alame asaa gidikko alame asay ba bagga gididaade dosees. Gido attiin intte alame bagga gidontta gishshas ta inttena alameppe shaakkada doorida gishshas derey inttena ixxees.
‹Ashkaray godaappe aadhdhenna› gaada ta kase inttes yootoyssa yuushshi qopite; istti tana gooddizayti inttenakka gooddana; istti ta qaalaa naagizaakko intte qaala naagana.
Istti tana kiittidaade erontta gishshas ta gaason intte bolla hessa wursi ooththana.
Ta yaada isttas yootonttaako isttas nagara gidenna. Ha7i qasse istta nagaraas hanno giza gaasoykka baa.
Tana ixxizaadey ta Aawaakka ixxees.
Hara asi ooththontta ooso ta istta giddon ooththonttaako isttas nagara gidennashin; ha7i istti hessa ubbaa be7idaappe guye tanakka ta Aawaakka ixxida.
Hessika haniday kase, ‹Tana gaasoykka baynda dishin ixxida› geetettidi istta wogan xaafettida qaalay polettanaassa.
«Gido attiin Aawappe kezidi yaanayssi, tanikka ta Aawa achchafe inttes yeddanayssi minththeththiza Tuma Ayanay yiidi izi ta gishshas markkattana.
Intte koyroppeka tanara diza gishshas taas intteka markkattandeta» gides.
